evidence.supports: 逐項手算P、總長、預留、用量及目標f/g的精確相等。
親跑每案例有/無cache相同新增ID及總長；G5 clip是repo處理容量的例子，不是唯一允許策略。

claims.statement: 本節C限制完整輸入與新增結果的總量；G/max_new_tokens只限制這次新增而不含prompt。增加G不增加C；滑動窗口或其他介面需另查長度契約。

claims.scope: 有限的完整歷史生成器契約。C不是KV記憶體bytes、tensor輸入fragment長或所有模型的通用物理／注意力window；HF生成max_length也不是独立C。

evidence.supports: max_new_tokens明確不计prompt；max_length生成設定被max_new_tokens覆蓋。

max_new_tokens會算生成max_length=P+G，沒有修改模型的實際position/capacity配置；不可把這個字段直接充當固定C。
保留舊KV時短新輸入fragment仍對應較長past+new序列；sliding eviction需獨立契約。

claims.statement: 預留不必寫滿；EOS是新增token並佔新增預算，未用容量不等於PAD。歷史EOS不會讓當前生成立即停止；核正常結束須分辨新選EOS、強制EOS與其他外部停止。

明定停止文字、強制EOS、PAD與EOS不同設定；容量空白不等於自动padding。
最後指定位置可強制EOS；同樣EOS輸出可有不同來源。
repo仅新選token==EOS才停，歷史含EOS仍生成；總容量／新增迴圈各有停止條件。
保存原ID和EOS flag，顯示不含EOS；單憑flag不区分强制來源。

factual_accuracy.details: Six grouped substantive claims cover all paragraphs and explicit API definitions; full-history bounded C/G contract, per-model serialization and EOS distinctions agree with personally inspected original authority. No material error or unknown identified within the stated scope.

numeric_verification.details: Original3+3+5+1=12 and C16/G4/G5, all full/EOS/budget/exercise cases executed in exact toy-token units. TinyLM cache axis2 and [B,T] sequence axis1 checked; floating tolerance1e-6/1e-5, observed1.7881393432617188e-7. This is no empirical score or training count.

figure_consistency.details: Viewed actual640/390 Inkscape renders. Slot positions1-12 and13-15, U/A/E, a-g dictionary, unused16, P12/C16/G4 and output3 agree with text and counts. No clipping seen; warnings did not prevent actual rasterization.

source_verification.details: Direct original HTTPS tagged and commit-pinned sources read; resolved v4.57.1→8cb5963 and v0.8.5→ba41cc9, bytes equality saved. Each claim has own original locator and support limits. Repo actual code hashes and permanently retained compact raw excerpts/execution provenance are recorded; no old reviewer conclusions used.

limitations.details: C is this explicitly full-history sequence budget, not universal context/physical-memory/sliding-window law. HF generation max_length is overridden by max_new_tokens, so it is not an independent C. No learned-answer guarantee, arbitrary tokenizer count, batch PAD behavior, full HF/vLLM runtime, GPU, re-training or deployed-model performance certified. Adjacent text read only for linked supervision.
